description: Source file implementing functions for converting JSON scalar types, memory formats, layouts, and device information, as well as the TensorMeta class constructor, within the torch::nativert namespace.

classes.name: TensorMeta
classes.description: Class representing tensor metadata, including data type, layout, device, shape, and strides, with a constructor that initializes these attributes from a serialized tensor metadata object.

methods.name: convertJsonScalarType
methods.description: Converts a serialized scalar type to c10::ScalarType.

methods.name: convertJsonMemoryFormat
methods.description: Converts a serialized memory format to c10::MemoryFormat.

methods.name: convertJsonLayout
methods.description: Converts a serialized layout to c10::Layout.

methods.name: convertJsonDevice
methods.description: Converts a serialized device object to c10::Device.
